item.title: Deadlock with Java ThreadPoolExecutor
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Demonstrates how ThreadPoolExecutor can cause deadlocks when parent tasks wait for child tasks that require the same executor. Shows deadlock scenario and potential workarounds.

item.title: emacs - Cheat Sheet
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: A practical Emacs cheat sheet for vim users transitioning to Emacs. Covers essential key combinations for file operations, window splitting, cursor movement, editing, and copy-paste.

item.title: JavaScript lookbehind RegEx alternative
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Workaround for JavaScript's lack of regex lookbehind using a two-step replace-and-split approach with a marker character to match conditional commas.

item.title: JS Quirks: stringified numbers
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: JavaScript quirk: stringified negative binary, octal, and hex numbers like '-0x1' return NaN when converted to numbers because only decimal literals can have signs per ECMAScript spec.

item.title: DSL-2730U router's ipv6 problem in Ubuntu
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Fix for DSL-2730U router not supporting IPv6 causing GitHub connection failures in Ubuntu. Solution disables IPv6 via sysctl.conf settings.

item.title: Sane ECMAScript 6 Generators
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Comparing ES6 Generators to Python generators - shows key difference where breaking out of a for-of loop closes the generator in JavaScript but not in Python.

item.title: Sublime Text 3 unhiding menu in Ubuntu - simpler solution
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Simpler method to toggle Sublime Text 3 menu visibility using keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+M) instead of editing config files.

item.title: Python 3.5 and Django 1.7's HTMLParseError
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Python 3.5 removed html.parser.HTMLParseError which breaks Django 1.7. Workaround involves upgrading Django or applying the django-autoconfig patch to fix the compatibility issue.

item.title: Ubuntu overlapping displays while scaling dual monitor setup
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Fix for overlapping displays when using xrandr --scale on dual monitor setup in Ubuntu. Shows how scaling affects virtual screen size and how to properly configure multiple monitors.

item.title: Python's venv problem with ensurepip in Ubuntu
item.author: sakthi@thefourtheye.in (Sakthipriyan Vairamani (thefourtheye))
item.description: Fix for Python 3.4 venv issues on Ubuntu 14.04. Workaround involves creating venv without pip first, then manually installing pip using get-pip.py bootstrap script.
